facts.fact: Le Matin reports that the Mouvement populaire bill insists on strict respect of Law 09.08 on personal data protection, treating it as the law that applies.

facts.fact: The Mouvement populaire group in the Chamber of Representatives filed a private bill adding an e-commerce chapter to consumer protection Law 31.08, with a 14-day withdrawal right and fines up to MAD 5 million.
facts.system: Proposition de loi complétant la loi 31.08
